missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Канал' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' and 'длинный' agree in masculine gender, describing the waterway.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Канал' is the accusative direct object of 'построили'; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Новый' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Канала' is genitive after 'из', marking the source of motion. 'Вода' is the nominative subject of 'вытекает'.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Каналу' is dative after 'по', expressing movement along a surface. 'Лодка' is the nominative subject of 'плывёт'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Канале' is prepositional after 'на', showing where the boats are. 'Много лодок' uses the genitive plural after a quantity word.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Каналом' is instrumental, governed by 'любуемся', which always takes that case. 'Красивым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Каналов' is genitive plural after 'много'. 'Старых' agrees, and 'в городе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Dative of goal. 'Каналу' is dative after 'к', naming the destination of movement. 'Купаться' is an infinitive of purpose.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Канал' is accusative after 'через', expressing crossing over; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Мост' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after preposition. 'Каналами' is instrumental plural after 'между', placing the road between them. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject.
